Your data is stored in Masroufi\'s private app storage, which Android isolates from other apps. The database itself is not encrypted by Masroufi; device encryption protects it when the phone is locked. Backups and WebDAV sync files are encrypted with your password (AES-256-GCM). The PIN is stored only as a salted hash, and the WebDAV password is encrypted with a key kept in Android Keystore.
Export an encrypted file you can keep anywhere. Restoring checks the password before changing anything. Receipt images are not included.
